nl.title: Wat is bandbreedte of dataverkeer?
nl.excerpt: Wat bandbreedte/dataverkeer is en hoe je het in DirectAdmin afleest.
nl.bodyHtml:
Bandbreedte is maandelijkse traffic. Pieken komen door downloads, bots of hotlinking.

Voorbereiding

  • Usage/stats toegang

Stappen

  1. Bekijk bandwidth usage in Account Manager / stats
  2. Identificeer pieken (logs/AWStats indien aanwezig)
  3. Optimaliseer zware files/CDN
  4. Blokkeer misbruikende IP’s indien nodig

Controleren

  • Begrip van verbruik vs. limiet

Tip: CDN verlaagt origin-traffic.

Let op: Overschrijding kan throttle/suspend veroorzaken volgens package.

Kom je er na deze stappen niet uit? Open een ticket bij TripleZero iT via het klantenpanel. Vermeld hostname, DirectAdmin-gebruikersnaam (geen wachtwoord), domein en wat je al probeerde.

Gerelateerd: usage-warning; ext-hoe-blokkeer-ik-een-ip-adres-in-directadmin.

en.title: What is bandwidth or data traffic?
en.excerpt: What is bandwidth or data traffic: what it is, where to manage it at TripleZero iT (DirectAdmin), and what to watch for.
en.bodyHtml:
What is bandwidth or data traffic comes up often with hosting, DNS, email or your control panel. Below is what it means and how you use it in practice at TripleZero iT.

You usually manage this via DirectAdmin. Always select the correct domain or account before changing anything.

In short

  • What is bandwidth or data traffic matters when you change configuration, availability or security of your services.
  • Wrong assumptions lead to wrong fixes: first confirm DNS, panel and application belong to the same domain.
  • Note your current setup (product, domain, panel) so the guidance matches your situation.

Where to manage it

  1. Sign in to DirectAdmin.
  2. Select the domain or subscription that “What is bandwidth or data traffic” applies to.
  3. Open the matching section (DNS, email, files, SSL, applications or account).
  4. Only change what you understand; take a backup before risky steps.

Practical points

  • Change one critical setting at a time so you can see cause and effect.
  • Always test outside the panel (browser, mail client or DNS lookup).
  • If you are unsure about impact on mail, SEO or checkout: read related articles or open a ticket.

Tip: Summarise in one sentence what “What is bandwidth or data traffic” means for your project before you change anything.

Note: Do not reuse passwords across services. Enable 2FA wherever available.

Still stuck? Open a ticket with TripleZero iT via the client panel. Include your domain name, what you already tried, and any exact error messages (text or screenshot).

Also browse other knowledge-base articles on hosting, email and security.
